zh.name: 计划
zh.heading: 评测计划
zh.description: 定义测量目标、场景来源、采集与标注方案、题量和验收条件。
zh.output: 需求、场景选择、采集方案与数量分配

en.name: Plan
en.heading: Evaluation plan
en.description: Define the goal, scene sources, collection and annotation plan, quantities and acceptance criteria.
en.output: Goal, scene selection, collection plan and allocation

zh.name: 场景选取或新建
zh.heading: 场景选取或新建
zh.description: 选取允许复用的场景或按计划新建，查看预览并验收场景版本。正式轨迹与传感器数据在 S3 采集。
zh.output: 选定或新建的场景、预览与场景验收回执

en.name: Select or create scenes
en.heading: Select or create scenes
en.description: Select permitted existing scenes or build planned scenes, inspect previews and accept scene revisions. Dataset trajectories and sensor recordings belong to S3.
en.output: Selected or new scenes, previews and scene acceptance receipts

zh.name: 采集
zh.heading: 采集
zh.description: 在已验收场景中采集轨迹、传感器观测和状态，完成标注、对齐与来源校验。预览样本不代表整批采集完成。
zh.output: 采集数据、标注、标定与来源校验回执

en.name: Collection
en.heading: Collection
en.description: Collect trajectories, sensor observations and states in accepted scenes, including annotation, alignment and source validation. Preview samples do not establish batch completion.
en.output: Collected data, annotations, calibration and validation receipts

zh.name: 出题
zh.heading: 评测配置与题目表
zh.description: 依据已验收的采集数据与标注按模板出题，查看数据集全集和样本。
zh.output: 题目、公开观测与数据集版本

en.name: Questions
en.heading: Evaluation config & questions
en.description: Produce questions from validated collection data and annotations; inspect dataset versions and samples.
en.output: Questions, public observations and dataset versions

zh.name: 质检与交付
zh.heading: 质检与交付
zh.description: 审查有效性、分区与覆盖，生成报告和交付版本。
zh.output: 质量结果、修复建议与交付包

en.name: Quality review and delivery
en.heading: Quality review and delivery
en.description: Inspect validity, splits and coverage; prepare reports and releases.
en.output: Quality results, repair proposals and packages
